w2p-editor.note: MVP 1-9 implemented, manually verified in-browser, and gap-analyzed at 100% match (9/9). One real bug found and fixed during QA (Fabric.js v6+ origin default change causing coordinate offset). Stretch goal 'product mockup preview' (t-shirt/mug SVG overlay) added and deployed to Vercel production.

history.note: Design document created: Fabric<->Zustand sync architecture, data model, component/file structure

MVP 1-9 built (Vite React18+TS scaffold at repo root, Zustand store, Fabric.js canvas, Toolbar/LayerPanel/PropertiesPanel). Found and fixed a real bug during manual QA: Fabric.js v6+ defaults object originX/originY to 'center' (not top-left), which was silently offsetting every object's position; fixed by converting between the layer model's top-left coords and Fabric's center-based coords in Canvas.tsx. Verified in-browser: add/move/rotate/align text & image layers, layer panel reorder/lock/duplicate/delete, undo/redo (incl. keyboard), localStorage + JSON file save/load round-trip, PNG export, and the mobile tab layout. npm run build passes with zero type errors. README written with run instructions and a requirements-mapping table.
